description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a function to split a string into tokens based on spaces and stores the tokens in a linked list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing string splitting functionality.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and stores them in a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it's considered valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
